title: Timezone Slot Proof
user: Solo professionals publishing booking links who need proof that their stated working hours produce the intended slots across invitee time zones and DST boundaries.
current_workaround: Create test bookings, manually reason about time zones, or discover wrong slots after a client books them.
smallest_useful_product: A static web tool that imports an ICS availability window or accepts weekly hours, renders the next 18 months of slots for selected zones, highlights DST discontinuities, and exports a shareable test matrix.
success_measure: For a seeded DST test suite, the tool flags 100% of intentionally shifted/missing slots and users can complete a five-zone review in under three minutes.
constraints: Use current IANA timezone data; label results as a configuration check rather than a guarantee of third-party scheduler behavior; avoid calendar credentials.
